scenes.chapter: Can you spot it before it runs?
scenes.vo: Can you tell a file is dangerous before it runs? You can, by what it would do. Here are three signs.
scenes.caption: Can you tell a file is dangerous before it runs? You can, by what it would do. Here are three signs.

scenes.chapter: Sign 1: it reads your documents in bulk
scenes.vo: Sign one. It goes after your documents in bulk. Reading every document at once is the first step towards encrypting them.
scenes.caption: Sign one. It goes after your documents in bulk. Reading every document at once is the first step towards encrypting them.

scenes.chapter: Sign 2: it deletes your way back
scenes.vo: Sign two. It deletes your way back. Ransomware deletes volume shadow copies, so your files cannot be restored.
scenes.caption: Sign two. It deletes your way back. Ransomware deletes volume shadow copies, so your files cannot be restored.

scenes.chapter: Sign 3: it hides inside something trusted
scenes.vo: Sign three. It hides inside something trusted. A document starts PowerShell, runs a hidden command, and injects into explorer.
scenes.caption: Sign three. It hides inside something trusted. A document starts PowerShell, runs a hidden command, and injects into explorer.exe.

scenes.chapter: One sign is not a verdict
scenes.vo: One sign alone can be normal. An installer writes a startup key too. Zero Write scores the behaviours together, before the file runs, and reaches a verdict.
scenes.caption: One sign alone can be normal. An installer writes a startup key too. ZeroWrite scores the behaviours together, before the file runs, and reaches a verdict.
